title: 2023 Panini Score Football Will Levis Base Rookie - Tennessee Titans
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2023 Panini Score Football card features Will Levis, a rookie player from the National Football League (NFL) team, Tennessee Titans. The card is a base parallel variety and has a card number of 303. It is a sports trading card manufactured by Panini and is part of the 2023 set. 

The card is not autographed, but it has been authenticated by Score. It is a great addition to any football fan's collection and is perfect for those who love trading cards. Get this unique piece of sports memorabilia today!
